name: Formamide
description: Formamide (CAS 75-12-7 ) is a primary amide solvent used across pharmaceutical synthesis, electronics manufacturing, and specialty chemical processing. It functions both as a high-polarity solvent and as a chemical intermediate in the production of active ingredients and industrial compounds. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, this compound serves as a reaction medium and building block for synthesizing purines, vitamins, and other heterocyclic compounds. The electronics industry relies on it as a solvent in the production of electrolytic capacitors. It is also utilized as a processing aid for certain polymer films. In textile and leather processing, it acts as a softening and conditioning agent, improving flexibility and workability of treated materials during the manufacturing process. Agrochemical producers also use this substance as an intermediate in the synthesis of pesticide and herbicide active substances. It is supplied as a clear, water-miscible liquid in standard bulk and drummed quantities for industrial use. Technical grade is the most common commercial specification, with high-purity grades available to meet pharmaceutical intermediate requirements. Suppliers typically offer material with defined purity thresholds, commonly 99% and above. The material is supported by relevant analytical documentation for regulated industries. This ensures that the product meets the necessary safety and quality benchmarks required for complex chemical synthesis and large-scale industrial applications.
